checked_declarations.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subset_expect
checked_declarations.type:
∀ {M : ℕ} (B : Finset (Fin M)) (f : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample Finset.univ B.card → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation M) fun σ => f (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset B σ)) =
    (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw Finset.univ B.card ⋯).expect f

checked_declarations.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_intersection_transform
checked_declarations.type:
∀ {M : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin M)) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s →
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation M) fun σ =>
        s ^ (A ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) B).card) ≤
      (1 - ↑B.card / ↑M + ↑B.card / ↑M * s) ^ A.card

checked_declarations.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEquiv
checked_declarations.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} →
    {j : Fin K} →
      RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j ≃ TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j

checked_declarations.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_expect
checked_declarations.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k)
  (f : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample Finset.univ (cuts.count j a) → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.columnPMF cuts j) fun c => f (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnDigitSubset a c)) =
    (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw Finset.univ (cuts.count j a) ⋯).expect f

checked_declarations.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_intersection_transform
checked_declarations.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k) (A : Finset (Fin N)) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s →
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.columnPMF cuts j) fun c => s ^ (A ∩ {i | ↑c i = a}).card) ≤
      (1 - ↑(cuts.count j a) / ↑N + ↑(cuts.count j a) / ↑N * s) ^ A.card
